---
title: "simstim debug bundle"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Write one local archive of the debug files, with private values replaced, to attach to an issue.

```text
simstim debug bundle [<host> | <host>/<session>] [flags]
```

Without an argument, the bundle takes the laptop's side only. With a host, it adds every session on that host that has debug files, and with a session, that session only. It writes simstim-debug-&lt;time&gt;.tar.gz in the current folder, with mode 0600. It replaces host names, addresses, user names, home folders, session names and folders, email addresses, SSH keys and the values of the host's alerts file. Nothing is uploaded. Read the files before you share them.

## Examples

```sh
simstim debug bundle my-vps/auth-fix
simstim debug bundle my-vps --ssh
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--ssh` | add the ssh -v log of one new connection to the host |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |

Part of [`debug`](debug.md): record why a session goes wrong: debug in a running session, profiles and the flight recorder.
